summary: Avoid rejecting honest sync peers while post-pivot blocks are being imported
details: Retain the total difficulty of headers validated during synchronization, so partial block execution moving the shared header marker backwards does not falsely report a stalling peer and roll back downloaded headers.

Continue rejecting peers whose advertised total difficulty exceeds both the current header chain and the headers validated in the sync cycle; include the promised, current and delivered difficulties in the rejection log.
Add deterministic partial-import and overstated-difficulty regressions for snap and light sync, and require their execution in Fast CI alongside queued-tip recovery tests.
